threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still walk across the street for a bus when the 38 is five minutes away. Locals just chill on the curb, saving their steps.
Caught a guy trying to sell a used umbrella on the 63 last night. Said it was lucky if you opened it at midnight. Only in Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid on a bike, juggling apples while his dog chased a pigeon—only in Neukölln, right? Just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you hop from a techno club to an authentic Turkish kebab stand at 5 AM and find it bustling with life, no matter the hour.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know you can run a red light at 16th and Mission during rush hour and still make it to the taco truck before the next bus comes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that was literally held up by a street performer doing magic tricks. Everyone was more entertained than upset about the delay.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are all about sipping cervezas, but locals know they're actually the best spots for spontaneous flamenco under the stars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they order 'café con leche'—too timid, no idea about the local 'café amb llet' vibe.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'The Tube' instead of 'the underground' and look confused when the bus takes the scenic route.
Spotted a guy on the 333 last night trying to feed pigeons his chips. They just stared, probably judging his life choices.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing soccer in the middle of the street while a bus honked to get by. Just another Saturday afternoon here.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves beer on tap from a bicycle. It's a mobile tap experience that really captures the DIY spirit.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the BART delays aren't just inconvenient; they’re a way of life. Tourist types just sigh and pull out their phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggle while waiting for the 19. Only in San Francisco would that be a Tuesday commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a café con leche anywhere, but the secret spots are small and often don’t have signage. They miss the real charm.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look baffled by the ticket machines at the metro, fumbling with coins like it's a foreign artifact.
